source_status: Liu arXiv:2509.02950v1 is unrefereed; only the M_{5,8} half is used

claims.statement: Over C, A^*(U_8) is tautological and U_8 has CKgP. M'_{5,8} to U_8 is a mu_5-gerbe with trivialized determinant; CKgP descends by Canning-Larson Lemma 3.6. Liu Proposition 2.5 has an inverse: a point of X is a smooth canonical genus-5 curve with n distinct marked points.

On M_{5,8} minus M^3_{5,8}, M_omega is irreducible of expected Porteous codimension 4 by the isomorphism M_omega cong W of L5. Fulton 14.4(c) therefore gives m[M_omega] with m>0, and [M_omega] is tautological over Q. Lower-gonality degeneracy components have higher codimension.
Normalized sequence (10) gives c(G)=c(L^vee tensor f_* omega_f); with c_1(L)=2 psi_i on M_omega this proves Liu Corollary 3.6. Dualizing (10) matches 0 to F to F' to O on BG.

The load-bearing fact is that BGL_4 -> BG is a representable A^4-bundle; Canning-Larson Lemma 3.5 then gives CKgP of BG. Liu cites Lemma 3.5 in Corollary 3.9 but justifies only the ordinary Chow-ring isomorphism.

Liu Proposition 3.3 is an isomorphism of stacks M_omega cong W. Liu's W is too big (missing p_8 disjoint from p_1..p_7). The family residual section plus the adjunction computation L^vee tensor f_* omega_f = F'^vee, G = F^vee makes both composites identities. Smoothness of M_omega is a consequence.
A^*(M_omega) is generated by restrictions of tautological classes, and M_omega has CKgP. Liu Lemma 3.8 should be read as -psi_i, not 3 psi_i.
Canning-Larson Lemma 9.9 applies at g=5, n=8 (n=8 <= g+7=12). Liu cites it in Corollary 2.11 but not in the citation list of Corollary 3.9.
Excision and Canning-Larson Lemma 3.4 glue L1, L6, L7 to A^*(M_{5,8})=R^*(M_{5,8}) and CKgP of M_{5,8}.
CLP Lemma 4.3 identifies W_24 H^{24} with the cycle-class image of A^{12}=R^{12}. Ionel Theorem 0.1 kills that cohomological image at degree 12; Chow vanishing of R^{12} is not used.
